notes: Express app.handle with the 100 routes registered via app.get/post/put and no middleware. Requests are minimal {method, url} objects; the fake response only provides a no-op setHeader.
details: Express application (app.handle) with the 100 routes registered via app.get/post/put. Request objects are minimal {method, url}; handlers store the matched pattern and req.params. The fake response object only provides a no-op setHeader (Express sets X-Powered-By). No middleware is registered.
